summary: Configured inventory-worker as an enabled, long-running systemd service on node1. It writes to /var/lib/inventory, cannot write outside its sandbox, cannot gain privileges, and recovered with preserved data after a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Applied strict filesystem and privilege confinement.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed persistence and recovery.

evidence.summary: The service is enabled and active, and its inventory log grew during observation.

evidence.requirement: Writes only inside /var/lib/inventory and gains no new privileges
evidence.summary: Runtime namespace tests denied writes to /etc and /tmp while allowing /var/lib/inventory; /proc reported NoNewPrivs=1 before and after reboot.
Captured the healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and post-restart service, sandbox, preserved-data, and continuing-write recovery.
